sentences.text: Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others Counsel for Petitioner :- Imran Khan,Javed Husain Khan

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Vikash Kumar Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Brij Raj Singh,J.

Heard learned counsel for petitioner, learned AGA for State-respondents and Sri Mayank Singh,
Advocate holding brief of Sri Vikash Kumar, learned counsel for respondent no.3.

The present writ petition has been preferred with the prayer to quash the FIR dated 13.03.2024 registered as Case Crime No.173 of 2024, under Sections 452, 376, 504, 506 IPC, Police Station - Kotwali Nagar, District - Banda.

There is allegation in the F.I.R. that petitioner has committed the offence of rape after entering into house of victim, besides committing the offences of criminal intimidation and causing her Yusuf vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186736257/
1 intentional hurt.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that present implication has been made by way of proceedings under Section 156 (3) Cr.P.C.
The petitioner has made several complaints before the Banda Development Authority against illegal construction being done by the other side.
The petitioner is not a Doctor, he is only a Journalist and has been falsely implicated in this case.

Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for informant have vehemently opposed the submissions made on behalf of learned counsel for the petitioner and they have submitted that serious allegations have been made against the petitioner and police investigation is still going on, therefore, he does not deserve any relief from this Court

After hearing the rival contentions and keeping in view the order dated 10.07.2024 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.7463 of 2024, this writ petition is disposed of with direction that till cognizance is taken on the police report submitted under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C. by the Investigating Officer, the petitioner shall not be arrested pursuant to the aforesaid First Information Report, subject to cooperation in ongoing investigation.
.
